kypExtensions.summary: The three-landmark reading of the ROC plane: the chance diagonal as the FLOOR ('No predictive value (AUC = 0.5)' — a test on it distinguishes the 2 groups no better than chance), the upper-left corner path as the CEILING ('Ideal test (AUC = 1)' — TP rate 1 at FP rate 0), and every real test's curve bowing up-left between them ('Actual test (0.5 < AUC < 1)'); plus the KYP readings 'every cutoff is one point on the curve' (sweeping the cutoff walks the point from bottom right toward the upper left) and 'AUC as ranking' (the probability the test ranks a random diseased person above a random healthy one — not printed).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the two body sentences, the three labeled traces, and the comparison rule; the floor/ceiling/curve landmark grammar, the cutoff-to-point mapping, and the ranking interpretation of AUC are KYP's synthesis.
kypExtensions.location: core.keyIdea MOVE 1 + mechanisms[0] auc-geometry + blocks[3] the decoder list block (LANDMARKS 1–5) + blocks[4] the steps block + the registry visual's Zone A (how-to-read panel + the one-cutoff dot + the AUC-gap arrow)

kypExtensions.summary: The two-error-family taxonomy wiring and the target grammar: RANDOM error degrades PRECISION (reliability — consistency and reproducibility), with the printed statistical shadows (↑ precision → ↓ standard deviation; ↑ precision → ↑ statistical power (1 − β)); SYSTEMATIC error/bias degrades ACCURACY (validity — closeness to the true values); on the printed targets, TIGHTNESS of the dart cluster = precision and CENTEREDNESS on the bullseye = accuracy, graded independently across all four combinations (tight+centered, tight+off-center, scattered+centered, scattered+off-center).
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the definitions, the four arrow lines, and the four targets; the scatters-vs-shifts grammar, the tight/centered grading rule, and the independence framing are KYP's organization.
kypExtensions.location: core.why + core.keyIdea MOVE 2 + mechanisms[1] error-type-split + blocks[3] (ERROR FAMILIES 1–2) + blocks[5] the compare block + the registry visual's Zone B (2×2 grid, per-cell error chips, printed-lines strip)

kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the printed page — 4 patterns (the two-curve AUC comparison stem, the on-the-diagonal AUC 0.5 stem, the consistent-but-miscalibrated device stem, the scattered-but-centered analyzer stem with the ↓SD/↑power follow-up), 4 traps (precision vs accuracy themselves; upper-LEFT vs upper-right corner; AUC vs single-cutoff sensitivity; the printed ↓SD/↑power consequences vs the never-printed 'precision improves accuracy'), 3 pivots (curve-description landmark routing; reliability/validity synonym swaps; the consistent-device praise-or-fault pivot), and 8 recall cards covering both blocks and both figures.
